summary: Describes the Zstandard (zstd) compression mechanism and registers a media type and content encoding for carrying zstd-compressed content in MIME. It is informational, as the word standard in the name does not make it an IETF standard. It was replaced by RFC 8878.

eli5.summary: Zstd squeezes files smaller, like vacuum-packing clothes. This gives it an official name so it can be sent in mail and web messages.
